thread:
maria_sales: Hey team — prospect (regional bank) wants a POC. They require BYOK with HSM-backed CMKs, dual-custody option, and a short rotation window. Can we confirm feasibility and what impacts pricing?

devon_se: Yep. Two quick vectors: 1) Hosted w/ HSM proxy (we call out to customer HSM via proxy) vs 2) Dedicated + customer-managed HSM in their VPC. Hosted is faster to onboard, Dedicated gives predictable throughput.

maria_sales: They explicitly asked for ephemeral wrapping keys for session-level encryption and attestation. Is that on our roadmap?

alex_crypto: We support ephemeral wrap via customer KEK. We can generate ephemeral data keys server-side, wrap with customer CMK (via PKCS#11 or CloudHSM API). Need attestation flow for key use — customer wants audit events for every wrap operation.

devon_se: Perf note: proxying to external HSM adds ~8–15ms per crypto op and can become a throughput bottleneck at scale. If they expect >500 qps of wrap/unwrap we should propose a local cache of wrapped prefixes or a hybrid where most tokens use cached KV.

ops_oncall: For POC we can run a 48h soak to measure latency. We also need firewall egress to customer HSM endpoints, and a stable network path. Ops will need IPs and a TLS mutual auth cert.

maria_sales: Pricing question for the customer: how do we price HSM calls? per-token or per-cryptographic-op? any guidance for dual-custody add-ons?

devon_se: Pricing model we recommend: base hosted per-token + an add-on for external KMS proxy per-1000 crypto ops (because of latency and ops overhead). Dedicated deals include a fixed monthly HSM-connect tier plus usage for high-volume wrap ops. Dual-custody / escrow increases onboarding and audit fees (one-time). I can sketch numbers after I get expected qps.

alex_crypto: Also flag compliance asks: they requested FIPS 140-2/3 attestation and tamper-evidence logs. For CloudHSM we can provide certs; for on-prem HSMs we need their attestation artifacts. Legal will need to sign a limited data access appendix.

legal_ryan: Yep — we'll need to fill their security questionnaire section on key custody. We can state: Redwood does not have access to CMK plaintext; we perform wrapped-key operations per customer policy. Need SOW language for split-key/digital escrow if customer requests key escrow.

maria_sales: Can someone draft a short POC runbook and a pricing slide I can show the customer? Meeting this Thurs preferred.

devon_se: I'll draft runbook: steps, IPs, tl;dr network needs, sample config. Example snippet for their side:
```
# sample HSM proxy config (customer firewall)
allow 10.0.8.32:443 -> redwood-proxy.example.com:8443
client-cert: /etc/keys/customer-mtls.pem
```
I'll post a draft by EOD tomorrow.

ops_oncall: I'll provision a small dedicated pool for the 48h soak and add monitoring dashboards (wrap latency, error-rate, tcp retransmits).

deploy-bot: ticket created — sales/POC-1788888888: "regional-bank BYOK POC". Assignee: devon_se. Due: 3 days.

maria_sales: Awesome. Quick Q: rotation window — they want daily rotations for ephemeral KEKs. Is that safe?

alex_crypto: Daily for ephemeral is fine (ephemeral = per-session or per-day). For CMKs you typically want longer rotation (30–90d) unless regulatory requires otherwise. We'll document recommended defaults in runbook.

maria_sales: Perfect. I'll sync with customer and set Thurs 10am PT. Thanks all :rocket:
